dedupe_keys.name: building energy estimation using episcope heuristic barcelona use case

description: Babak Ebrahimi publishes Barcelona building-level energy estimates generated with the EPISCOPE heuristic for FAIRiCUBE Use Case 4. The July 2025 deposit supplies Barcelona_EPISCOPE.geojson under CC BY 4.0. The rule-based method uses building age, type and geometry, including height and footprint, to estimate energy performance. These spatial outputs can support neighbourhood demand scenarios and building-stock energy simulations. Related catalogue record data-tabula-episcope-building-typologies provides context for the underlying typologies; it does not explicitly include this Barcelona output. The freely downloadable data describe estimated, not metered demand. Units, weather assumptions, building counts and uncertainty remain unknown from the landing-page description. The GeoJSON and its coordinate reference system were not inspected. Comparison with the project’s Barcelona machine-learning output requires checking shared identifiers and consistent demand definitions.
